entries.relevance: Termination-measure design (task 434 blocker): proves decidability for S5 combined with linear tense logic via the MOSAIC METHOD — bounding the model-search space by a finite set of compatible local configurations ('mosaics') rather than by a counter over an unboundedly-growing time set.
